people.name: Ernest Renan
people.field: Semitic scholar, historian of religion, philologist, philosopher, biblical scholar

relations.subject: Ernest Renan
relations.evidence: in 1844 he entered the college of St Sulpice in order to take his degree in philology prior to entering the church

relations.subject: Ernest Renan
relations.evidence: by day, he studied Hebrew and Syriac under Arthur-Marie Le Hir.

relations.subject: Ernest Renan
relations.evidence: In October 1845, Renan left Saint Sulpice for Stanislas... and entered M. Crouzet's school for boys as a teacher.

relations.subject: Marcellin Berthelot
relations.evidence: revealed to Renan in 1846 by the chemist Marcellin Berthelot, then a young man of eighteen, his pupil at M. Crouzet's school.

relations.subject: Ernest Renan
relations.evidence: To the day of Renan's death, their friendship continued.

relations.subject: Yannis Psycharis
relations.evidence: and Noémi, born in 1862, who eventually married philologist Yannis Psycharis.
